additions.description: The GET /items/ endpoint is accessible to any authenticated active user, not just superusers. The specification only describes superusers retrieving the item list.
additions.reasoning: The spec only shows a superuser scenario for listing all items. The code allows any authenticated user to call GET /items/ and receive all items in the system, which the spec does not positively require.

omissions.description: The GET /items/{item_id} endpoint does not check ownership permissions. A non-superuser can read items they do not own, but the spec requires HTTP 400 with detail 'Not enough permissions' in that case.
omissions.reasoning: The specification explicitly states: 'Attempt to read the created item using the access token of the second user. Verify that the response status code is 400 and the response body contains a detail field with the value "Not enough permissions"'. The code's read_item handler returns the item to any authenticated user without any ownership check.

omissions.description: The POST /api/v1/users/signup endpoint returns error detail 'User with this email already exists' for duplicate emails, but the specification requires 'The user with this email already exists in the system'.
omissions.reasoning: The specification test states: 'Verify the response body field "detail" equals "The user with this email already exists in the system"' for the duplicate signup scenario. The code raises HTTPException with a different message string.
